'''Sith Hunters''' were specialized elite troops of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Equipment & Weapons==
Sith Hunters were extremely skilled in combat. They wore [[Reinforced Insulated Sheath armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Sith Hunters are [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] (NPCs) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. They wear the same armor as Rebel [[Weapons master/Legends|weapons masters]] and are either called "a veteran Sith Hunter" or "a decorated Sith Hunter".

Sith Hunters only appear when a city or planetary region of the game has been under the control of Rebel-aligned players for a prolonged period of time. When they spawn, they patrol the area and attack all Imperial NPCs and players.
